items.text: For adults with migraine attending the headache clinic, what are the costs and consequences for the clinic of switching from paper to app diaries in January 2027, comparing six months before with six months after, and what is the three-year budget impact on injectable preventives?
items.population: Adults with migraine with a follow-up appointment in the headache clinic, July 2026 to June 2027
items.intervention: App diaries from January 2027, with paper kept on request
items.outcome: Clinic cost per appointment episode (set-up time, appointment time, repeat appointments), usable diaries, preventive prescriptions and budget impact
items.time: Six months either side of the switch; three-year budget horizon

finer: Feasible with existing data and four nurse hours a week; interesting to the clinic manager and the budget holders; novel because no retrieved study costs the switch; ethical as a service evaluation; relevant because the switch date is fixed.
summary: One costing question that follows the investigator's selected hypothesis h2.
